All 18 pytest tests and Next.js production build pass.

steps_completed.action: Aligned UI terminology with user-first supporting material UX model and progressive disclosure
steps_completed.finding: Eliminated detective/auditor jargon (Attach Evidence -> Add Supporting Material, Evidence Format -> File / Content Type, submission_proof.txt -> submission_notes.txt, Verified -> Satisfied, Missing Evidence -> Missing Material, Evidence Changed -> Material Changed). Positioned SHA-256 and AST grammar under clean 'Processing Details' progressive disclosure. All 18 pytest tests and Next.js 15 production build pass cleanly.

steps_completed.action: Updated README.md to reflect user-first supporting material model and complete project architecture
steps_completed.finding: Rewrote README.md with the UX Principle ('Never make the user prove that they are a detective'), 4-stage pipeline (Source Material -> Extraction -> Check -> Result), full project directory structure including rule_parser.py and custom error views, and updated testing suite to 18 test cases.

steps_completed.action: Implemented Content Studio post & article preparation workspace with rich WYSIWYG editing, multi-target export, and contextual AI selection rewrite
steps_completed.finding: Created components/content-studio-modal.tsx and app/api/content-studio/rewrite/route.ts. Implemented direct formatting (Bold, Italic, Headings, Lists, Quotes, Code, Emojis, Undo/Redo, Find/Replace), targets (LinkedIn with 3000-char counter and hashtag tracker, Website/Blog, Markdown, HTML, Plain Text), dual preservation (original AI draft retained + version history ledger), contextual AI selection actions (Improve, Shorten, Expand, Technical, Grammar, Translate), and integrated into DevLog, reflection turns, top action bar, and verification dossier export. All 18 pytest tests and Next.js 15 production build pass cleanly.

steps_completed.finding: 1) Added Project Verification Navigator in sidebar during verification mode displaying active project 'AWS Zero to Shipped 2026', readiness score (100%), status breakdown (5 satisfied, 0 review, 0 missing), and interactive requirement check items.
